package wrongrawhook

import (
	"example.com/ridu-gate1/field"
	"example.com/ridu-gate1/operation"
)

var _ = field.Text("title").Hooks(field.Hooks[string]{
	BeforeValidate: []field.RawTransform{
		func(operation.WriteContext, operation.Value[any]) (operation.Change[any], error) {
			return operation.Change[any]{}, nil
		},
	},
})
